title: Stellar Fusion Plus
tagline: We are extending fusion plus to stellar to support Eth to Stellar transaction
description:
This is a comprehensive cross-chain atomic swap protocol that extends 1inch's Fusion+ technology to enable seamless token exchanges between Ethereum and Stellar networks. The project implements a novel bidirectional atomic swap architecture that allows users to trade assets across these two major blockchain ecosystems with enhanced security and efficiency.

Key Components:

Smart Contracts: Ethereum-based contracts using 1inch Fusion+ integration with HTLC (Hash Time Locked Contracts) for secure cross-chain operations
Stellar Integration: Soroban smart contracts providing Stellar-side swap functionality
Backend Services: Node.js backend with swap coordination, resolver management, and order processing
how_its_made:
Built using a multi-chain architecture:

Ethereum Layer: Solidity smart contracts extending 1inch Fusion+ protocol with HTLC (Hash Time Locked Contracts) for cross-chain atomic swaps
Stellar Layer: Rust-based Soroban smart contracts providing Stellar-side swap functionality
Backend: Node.js service with Express.js handling swap coordination, resolver management, and order processing
